name: – Dainius Žalimas – After § 48 – Am 11
title: REPORT on monitoring the application of European Union law in 2023, 2024 and 2025
part_text: 48a. Regrets the Commission’s ideologically driven approach to energy policy, particularly in relation to the monitoring of the implementation of the Renewable Energy Directive; strongly criticises the infringement procedure initiated against France on 25 September 2024, as well as the subsequent indication, in the reasoned opinion of 30 January 2026, of a possible referral to the Court of Justice of the European Union with a view to imposing financial penalties; recalls that, pursuant to Article 194(2) TFEU, Member States retain the right to determine their own energy mix and should therefore be able to exercise this competence without undue interference;
